data.name: Raphaelon
data.gender_notes: Raphaelon is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raphaelon is derived from the Hebrew name Raphael, which means 'God heals'. In the Old Testament, Raphael is one of the seven archangels, and he is known for his healing powers. The Greek form of the name is Raphael, and the Latin form is Raphaelus. In Christian tradition, Raphael is also the name of a biblical figure who helps the Israelites during the Babylonian captivity and a saint venerated for his healing powers.
data.etymology: Raphaelon belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God heals.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raphaelon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Raphaelon
in_english.long_meaning: Raphaelon is derived from Hebrew roots ר-פ-א (R-P-A), meaning 'God heals' or 'God is the healer'. It signifies divine intervention in healing and restoration, reflecting a spiritual connotation of physical and emotional healing. Historically, the name Raphael, from which Raphaelon is likely inspired, appears in the Book of Tobit in the New Testament Apocrypha, where Raphael is an archangel associated with healing. The name is popular in Christian traditions for its association with divine care and protection.

historical_references.reference: In the 16th century, Raphaelon was a popular given name in Italy, believed to have been derived from the biblical Archangel Raphael, known for his healing powers.
During the Middle Ages, Raphaelon was used as an alternative name for Raphael, the Archangel, in various religious texts and artwork, symbolizing divine healing and protection.
